context.summary: Chitosan nanoparticles (CNPs) with recombinant C. psittaci antigens physically adsorbed, used as an adjuvant and delivery system for a mucosal plus intramuscular chlamydia vaccine in mice. The paper reports CNP size, PDI, zeta potential, TEM morphology and antigen adsorption efficiency, plus immune and lung-challenge readouts.

context.summary: Liposomes (AsAcP@LP) co-encapsulating arsenate (As5+ pro-drug), allicin (ATR inhibitor and H2S donor) and octreotide, designed to reactivate mutant p53 and induce synthetic lethality in p53-mutant NSCLC. The paper characterizes the liposomes by TEM, EDS, XPS and H2S release, and reports cell and xenograft antitumor tests.

samples.composition: DOPC, DOTAP, cholesterol, DSPE-PEG2000 liposomes co-loaded with sodium arsenate (As5+), allicin and octreotide acetate; phospholipid:cholesterol 3:1

articles.notes: Numeric DLS size, PDI and zeta values for AsAcP@LP are in Fig. 1F and SI tables only; encapsulation efficiency and drug loading (ICP, HPLC) are given only qualitatively in the packet text. Cell, xenograft and transcriptome data not recorded. Carrier is a liposome with an arsenic pro-drug, not a virus or PCR-dependent system.

context.summary: PLGA microparticles (about 1-10 µm) loading the photosensitizer Radachlorin (mixed chlorin e6, chlorin p6 and purpurin 5 sodium salts), made by W/O/W or W/O/O double emulsion, for prolonged-release photodynamic therapy. The paper characterizes size, zeta potential, RC content, optical spectra and singlet oxygen, with in vitro cell tests.
